terra.problem: “Same road, different destination” has no clear comparison or setup, so the joke does not make sense.
The text says the bird is released into the open field; it does not say it flies off.
“Nobody's getting a roommate here” rules out an arrangement the passage does not address.
The passage says he remains outside his tent, not that he camps near it.
The passage does not say the distance from outside the camp to the entrance was a long way.
The passage does not identify the bird's release as happening on the first day.
“The priest already saw to that” suggests the priest brought about the healing. He examined the person and found the disease had healed.
The text says the birds are chosen according to what the person can afford, but does not say who makes the choice. The priest also does more than just receive the birds; he sacrifices them.
The passage orders the house cleared before the priest enters; it does not say nobody is allowed to enter beforehand.
“There isn't a third scraping” implies a second scraping. The passage describes one scraping before the mildew reappears.
